hero.title: COPOR
hero.subtitle: An airsoft club built on discipline, teamwork, and respect for the field.
about.title: Who is Copor
about.body: Copor is an airsoft club dedicated to tactical play, field discipline, and camaraderie. We regularly run trainings and operations, work on gear and tactics, and are always looking for new members who share the same passion for airsoft.
about.card1Body: A symbol of leadership and instinct — the wolf head as our team's mark.
about.card2Body: Focus on the target, tactics, and continuous improvement.
about.card3Body: Team, discipline, and trust — above all else.
rules.title: Rulebook
rules.intro: Our trainings and operations follow the Serbian Airsoft Rulebook (SASP) and the supplements used at events run by the wider airsoft community. Below is a summary of the most important safety rules — full rules are explained before every event.
rules.eyewearBody: Eye protection/mask must be worn on the field at all times and never removed, no matter the circumstances.
rules.hitBody: A hit to any part of the body, gear, or replica (including from a teammate) counts. The player lowers their replica, calls out loudly, puts on a kill rag (a 40×40cm fluorescent orange/red cloth), and heads to spawn by the shortest route without talking to active players.
rules.blindfireBody: Firing without looking at your target (around a corner, over cover, while running) is strictly forbidden. Full-auto fire is banned under 10m.
rules.disputeBody: Every disputed situation is resolved against yourself, no arguing on the field. Fair play comes before everything else.
rules.substancesBody: Consuming alcohol or psychoactive substances before or during an event is strictly forbidden.
rules.energyBody: Pistol/shotgun up to 1.5J with no MED; assault up to 1.5J, 10m MED for full-auto; LMG up to 1.9J, 20m MED; DMR up to 2.3J (semi-auto only), 20m MED; sniper up to 3.3J, 30m MED. Chronographing is mandatory before play starts.

pravilnikPage.title: Serbian Airsoft Rulebook (SASP)
pravilnikPage.intro: This is a summary of the rules that apply at our club's trainings and operations, based on the Serbian Airsoft Rulebook (SASP) and the supplements used by the wider airsoft community. The goal is safe, fair, and team-oriented play for everyone.
pravilnikPage.eyewearBody: Eye protection or a mask is worn on the field at all times and never removed, no matter the circumstances.
pravilnikPage.substancesBody: Consuming alcohol or psychoactive substances immediately before or during an event is strictly forbidden.
pravilnikPage.arrivalBody: Don't arrive at an event already dressed in military/police uniforms or wearing MUP/Ministry of Defence insignia. Replicas are carried on safe with no magazine, in a bag or case, until play begins.
pravilnikPage.hitBody: A hit to any part of the body, gear, or replica — including from a teammate — counts. The player lowers their replica, calls out loudly, puts a kill rag (a 40×40cm fluorescent orange or red cloth) in plain view, and leaves the field by the shortest route without talking to active players. Night games use a glowing kill rag (a red light near the head/shoulder).
pravilnikPage.blindfireBody: Firing without looking at your target (around a corner, over cover, while running) is strictly forbidden. Full-auto fire is banned under 10m. "Bang bang" doesn't count — the opponent has to be actually hit by a BB.
pravilnikPage.specialHitsBody: When two players hit each other in practically the same instant (a cross kill), both leave the game. A silent kill is a light touch with a hand or a training melee replica, with no call-out — the victim quietly displays their kill rag. A ricochet (a BB deflected through branches/foliage) doesn't count as a hit.
pravilnikPage.disputeBody: Every disputed situation is resolved against yourself, with no arguing on the field. If someone won't acknowledge a hit, call yourself out and take it to a marshal.
pravilnikPage.conductBody: Targeting civilians (photographers, bystanders) or animals is forbidden. BBs are not picked up off the ground, and litter goes only in designated bins. Only certified smoke grenades are allowed — no pyrotechnics.
pravilnikPage.energyTitle: Replica energy and minimum engagement distance (MED)
pravilnikPage.energyIntro: Energy (J) and minimum engagement distance (MED) values by replica class. Chronographing (using only 0.20g BBs) is mandatory before play starts.
pravilnikPage.noteAssault: MED applies to full-auto; no full-auto indoors
pravilnikPage.noteDmr: Semi-auto only, min. 1s between shots, ≥4x optic
pravilnikPage.energyFoonote: Players carrying long replicas (LMG/DMR/sniper) must also carry a sidearm for engagements under the prescribed MED.
pravilnikPage.grenadesBody: Only certified airsoft grenades are allowed. A grenade's effect applies within a 3m radius — a player in that range calls themself out even without a direct BB hit, unless they're fully out of the blast's line of sight.
pravilnikPage.lightsBody: Flashlights up to 2000 lumens are allowed. Lasers and PEQ devices are not. A red filter is reserved for the night kill rag.
pravilnikPage.shieldsBody: Only shields that faithfully represent a real model are allowed, weighing at least 25% of the original. A shield carrier is limited to a sidearm or one-handed SMG replica, with no full-auto fire.
pravilnikPage.dronesBody: Drones and RC vehicles are allowed for recon only — engaging them is forbidden. Real edged or firearm weapons are strictly forbidden; only a small knife or multitool is allowed on the field as a tool.
pravilnikPage.source: This summary follows the Serbian Airsoft Rulebook (SASP) and the rulebook used at Beoshot community events in Železnik — full source rulebook (PDF). Each event's organizer may add extra or stricter rules, explained before play begins.

aszJugPage.title: ASZ JUG — Airsoft Community South
aszJugPage.intro: ASZ JUG (Airsoft zajednica jug / Airsoft Community South) is a regional airsoft community from southern Serbia.
aszJugPage.notice: We weren't able to find an official, publicly available page for the ASZ JUG community, so we're leaving this section open to fill in. If you represent ASZ JUG or have an official link (website, Facebook, or Instagram page), send it to us via the contact section and we'll add an accurate description and contact details.
